title: Async cancellation rebinding preserves asynchronous resource cleanup

acceptance.description: Add async idle token rebinding with the same guards, independent budget cancellation and exact token propagation as sync binding; cancellation drains live handles via existing async cleanup and preserves primary cancellation exception.
Focused async-only delayed disposal tests prove actual suspension, exactly-once drain, busy/reentrant/faulted/disposed guards, and unchanged counters/handles on successful rebinding.
Preserve existing sync/async resolver behavior with affected tests, applicable allocation evidence and planning validation at a known implementation revision.

handoff.summary: Requested by async core worker: sync BindCancellationToken can fault/drain through synchronous stream disposal; optional async binder required before resource continuation consumption.
